## What does this change?

<!-- One or two sentences in plain language. -->

## Why?

<!-- What was wrong, missing, or worth improving. If it's a factual correction
     (a phone number, an address, hours), link or name your source so it can be
     verified. -->

## What did you touch?

- [ ] Page content or wording only (`.html`, `.css`, text)
- [ ] Community data (`community-events.json`, `updates.json`)
- [ ] Site logic (JavaScript inside a page, or `nav.js`)
- [ ] **Data scripts** (`scripts/`) or **workflows** (`.github/`) or **`api/`**

<!-- That last box is the one that matters most. Those files run automatically
     with access to the project's API key, so they get a closer look and may
     take longer to merge. Nothing wrong with them, just be explicit. -->

## How did you check it?

<!-- e.g. "ran node server.js, loaded /living on my phone, tapped the new
     number." No test suite exists, so a note on what you actually saw helps. -->

## Anything I should know?

<!-- Uncertainties, follow-ups, things you deliberately left out. -->
